findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_service, get_portfolio_item, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post, get_contact, search_content · Private data: get_contact, send_message · Public sink: get_blog_post, get_contact, send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_service, get_portfolio_item, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post, get_contact, search_content · Private data: get_contact, send_message · Public sink: get_blog_post, get_contact, send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
